name: API Isarud Trade Compliance
author: Seçkin Sefa Durası

sections.description:
The most comprehensive free trade compliance and marketplace integration plugin for WordPress.

🆓 100% Free — Unlike other marketplace plugins that lock essential features behind paid tiers, Isarud gives you everything for free. Sanctions screening, marketplace sync, product import/export, variation support, CSV tools — all included.

✨ NEW in v4.2

  • 🔄 Two-way stock sync + Webhooks — Real-time stock updates from marketplaces
  • 📦 Order import — Pull orders from Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11 into WooCommerce
  • 📥 Product import — Import product catalogs from marketplaces with preview
  • 📤 Product export — Upload WooCommerce products to marketplaces (single or bulk)
  • 🎨 Variation support — Sync products with size, color, and other variants
  • 🗂️ Category & attribute mapping — Map categories and attributes between platforms
  • 📊 CSV import/export — Bulk import from CSV, export to Excel-compatible CSV
  • ⚡ HPOS compatibility — WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • ☁️ Cloud Sync — Sync all data to isarud.com for cross-platform access
  • 📋 Dashboard guide — Step-by-step setup wizard for new users

🛡️ Always Free (No WooCommerce Required)

Connect your WordPress site to isarud.com and access:

  • Sanctions Screening — 8 international lists, 32,000+ records (OFAC SDN, EU, UN, UK HMT, Canada SEMA, Australia DFAT, World Bank)
  • AI Risk Briefs — OSINT intelligence reports powered by Claude AI
  • HS Code Lookup — 6,938 codes at 6-digit level
  • US Export Control Lists — 11 USG lists (CSL)
  • Dual-Use Product Check — Wassenaar + EU dual-use regulations
  • Cloud Sync — Access your data from iOS, Android, Windows, macOS apps
  • PDF Reports, Portfolio Management, Alerts

🛒 Free with WooCommerce

Install WooCommerce to unlock the full marketplace suite:

  • 6 Marketplace Integrations — Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon SP-API, Pazarama, Etsy
  • Two-way stock synchronization with webhook support
  • Order import from marketplaces to WooCommerce
  • Product import from marketplace catalogs (with preview)
  • Product export from WooCommerce to marketplaces (single or bulk)
  • Variation support — Size, color, and other variant sync
  • Category mapping — WooCommerce ↔ marketplace categories
  • Attribute mapping — Color, size, brand attribute mapping
  • CSV import/export — Bulk import, Excel-compatible export
  • Auto sync — WP Cron: 15min / 1hr / 6hr / daily
  • Price margin/markup — Percentage or fixed amount per marketplace
  • Bulk sync — Sync all products with progress bar
  • Dropshipping — Supplier management + auto-forward orders
  • Affiliate marketing — Referral codes + commission tracking
  • Auto sanctions screening — Screen every new WooCommerce order
  • HPOS compatible — High-Performance Order Storage

Marketplace Support Matrix

  • Trendyol — Stock ✅ Price ✅ Product Upload ✅ Product Import ✅ Order Import ✅ Webhooks ✅
  • Hepsiburada — Stock ✅ Price ✅ Product Upload ✅ Product Import ✅ Order Import ✅ Webhooks ✅
  • N11 — Stock ✅ Price ✅ Product Upload ✅ Product Import ✅ Order Import ✅ Webhooks ✅
  • Amazon SP-API — Stock ✅ Price ✅
  • Pazarama — Stock ✅ Price ✅
  • Etsy — Stock ✅ Price ✅

14 Admin Pages

Dashboard (with setup guide), Sanctions Screening, Marketplace APIs, Bulk Sync, Dropshipping, Affiliates, Order Import, Product Import, Product Export, Category Mapping, Attribute Mapping, CSV Operations, Webhooks, Cloud Sync, Sync Log.

🇹🇷 Türkçe

WordPress için en kapsamlı ücretsiz ticaret uyum ve pazar yeri entegrasyon eklentisi.

Diğer pazar yeri eklentileri temel özellikleri ücretli versiyona kilitlerken, Isarud her şeyi ücretsiz sunar.

v4.2’deki Yenilikler:

  • 🔄 Çift yönlü stok sync + Webhook desteği
  • 📦 Pazar yerinden sipariş çekme (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11)
  • 📥 Pazar yerinden ürün çekme (katalog import, önizle + aktar)
  • 📤 Pazar yerine ürün yükleme (tek veya toplu)
  • 🎨 Varyasyonlu ürün desteği (beden, renk sync)
  • 🗂️ Kategori ve attribute eşleştirme
  • 📊 CSV import/export (Excel uyumlu, Türkçe sütun adları destekli)
  • ⚡ HPOS uyumluluğu (WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage)
  • ☁️ Cloud Sync — isarud.com ile veri senkronizasyonu
  • 📋 Dashboard rehber — adım adım kurulum kılavuzu

Her Zaman Ücretsiz (WooCommerce gerekmez):

  • Yaptırım taraması (8 uluslararası liste, 32.000+ kayıt)
  • AI Risk Brief (OSINT istihbaratı)
  • HS Kod Arama (6.938 kod)
  • ABD İhracat Kontrol Listesi (11 liste)
  • Çift Kullanımlı Ürün Kontrolü
  • Cloud Sync — iOS, Android, Windows, macOS erişim
  • PDF rapor, portföy yönetimi, uyarılar

WooCommerce ile Ücretsiz:

  • 6 pazar yeri entegrasyonu (Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11, Amazon, Pazarama, Etsy)
  • Çift yönlü stok senkronizasyonu + Webhook
  • Sipariş aktarımı, ürün aktarımı, ürün yükleme
  • Varyasyonlu ürün desteği (beden, renk)
  • Kategori ve attribute eşleştirme
  • CSV import/export
  • Otomatik sync (15dk / 1saat / 6saat / günlük)
  • Fiyat margin, toplu sync, dropshipping, affiliate
  • Otomatik yaptırım taraması
sections.installation:
English

  1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from WordPress.org
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Isarud > Dashboard and follow the setup guide
  4. Connect to isarud.com via Cloud Sync page
  5. (Optional) Add marketplace API credentials in Marketplace APIs

Türkçe

  1. Eklentiyi /wp-content/plugins/ dizinine yükleyin veya WordPress.org’dan kurun
  2. Eklentiyi etkinleştirin
  3. Isarud > Dashboard‘a gidin ve kurulum rehberini takip edin
  4. Cloud Sync sayfasından isarud.com’a bağlanın
  5. (Opsiyonel) Pazar Yeri API sayfasından pazar yeri bilgilerinizi girin
sections.faq:
Is this plugin really free?

Yes! All features are 100% free. The only paid component is the optional isarud.com subscription for higher sanctions screening limits (free plan: 10/month).

Bu eklenti gerçekten ücretsiz mi?

Evet! Tüm özellikler %100 ücretsiz. Tek ücretli bileşen, daha yüksek tarama limitleri için opsiyonel isarud.com aboneliğidir (ücretsiz plan: ayda 10 tarama).

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Without WooCommerce, you can still use sanctions screening, HS code lookup, and other compliance tools. WooCommerce unlocks marketplace features.

WooCommerce gerekli mi?

Hayır. WooCommerce olmadan da yaptırım taraması, HS kod arama ve diğer uyum araçlarını kullanabilirsiniz. WooCommerce, pazar yeri özelliklerini açar.

Which marketplaces are supported?

Trendyol, Hepsiburada, N11 (full support: stock, price, product upload/import, order import, webhooks). Amazon SP-API, Pazarama, Etsy (stock and price sync).

How does two-way sync work?

Set up webhook URLs in your marketplace seller panels. When an order comes in from the marketplace, WooCommerce stock is automatically updated. See Isarud > Webhooks page for URLs.

Çift yönlü sync nasıl çalışır?

Pazar yeri satıcı panellerinden webhook URL’lerini ayarlayın. Pazar yerinden sipariş geldiğinde WooCommerce stoğu otomatik güncellenir. URL’ler için Isarud > Webhooks sayfasına bakın.
